thread:
Alyssa (People Ops): Heads up  multiple folks pinging about missing employer match for April contributions. Anyone on benefits/payroll seen issues?
Noah (Payroll): We got 4 tickets so far. Payroll shows employee deferrals were withheld but vendor reports match file not applied on their end. They claim a migration script dropped the match rows.
Priya (Benefits): I pulled the Sunrise plan ledger. Contributions and loan payments look ok, but employer match column is blank for ~120 participants for the 2024-04-26 pay period.
Diego (Finance): How much $ are we talking? I need a quick exposure estimate to flag finance ops.
Noah (Payroll): Quick calc from payroll preview: approx $18,400 employer match missing for April. Many are small matches but there are a few high-earners with large match amounts.
Alyssa (People Ops): Oof. Two immediate questions: 1) did vendor miss deposit (money not sent) or just ledger entries missing? 2) are employees seeing lowered balances in their accounts?
SunriseSupport: Hi team  Sunrise engineering: a migration edge-case caused `match_amount` rows to be omitted during database import for April. Deposits: bank shows batch sent on 04/30 but reconciliation failed to link amounts to individual accounts. We're rebuilding mapping table now. Apologies.
Priya (Benefits): So bank received funds but they weren't allocated to accounts? That is better than missing cashflow but still bad for employees.
SunriseSupport: Correct. We have the batch keyed, funds are in the omnibus account. We need Redwood-provided employee identifiers to match against the deposit trace. We can reapply retro once we receive mapping confirmation.
Noah (Payroll): We can provide a CSV mapping. Sample (redacted):
```
employee_id,last4,match_amount,pay_date
51234,4321,75,2024-04-26
51298,8899,120,2024-04-26
51322,1111,35,2024-04-26
```
Alyssa (People Ops): Action plan draft: A) Benefits/Payroll produce canonical mapping CSV with emp_id/last4/ssn_last4/pay_date/match_amount. B) Sunrise will apply mapping and confirm per-employee applied status. C) Finance confirm omnibus deposit amount equals sum of match_amounts. D) Draft participant communication acknowledging delay + ETA. E) Decide off-cycle top-up or one-time reallocation timing. Thoughts?
Diego (Finance): I'll reconcile bank incoming batch. If funds in omnibus = payroll sum we can avoid extra cash movement. If mismatch, we may need expedited transfer. I can have first-pass recon in 2 hours.
Priya (Benefits): I'll generate the mapping CSV tonight and include loan/vest flags so we can apply match consistent with plan rules. Note: some employees' matches may be subject to vesting schedule; we should not mis-vest.
Marta (Legal): Confirming: under plan docs and ERISA, plan fiduciaries must correct mistakes promptly. If employees suffered loss (e.g., missing market gains because match applied late) we may need to make whole. Also check disclosure obligations for late deposits. I'll review legal notice obligations and draft recommended employee language.
Noah (Payroll): Also flag payroll timing: if we instruct Sunrise to reapply on 05/10 they may show deposits with 05/10 posting date; for tax/reporting we should preserve original pay_date (04/26) if possible. Ask Sunrise if they can backdate ledger entries.
SunriseSupport: We can reapply with original payroll date metadata to preserve YTD reporting, but if tax reporting system relies on posting date we will include an explanatory field. We'll confirm exact behavior after mapping.
Alyssa (People Ops): For communications: short urgent note first: "We identified a processing error causing delayed employer match allocations for April payroll. No employee funds were lost; Sunrise has the deposits and we're working to reapply allocations. Expect a follow-up with timing and any action required." Then FAQ: will I be taxed? will vesting change? do I need to take action?
Priya (Benefits): I'll draft FAQ. Quick answers: 1) Taxes: employer match is employer contribution (not taxable to employee at time of deposit) but timing can affect Roth/after-tax interplay; we will confirm tax treatment after Sunrise confirms backdating. 2) Vesting: we will honor plan vesting schedule; if delay caused loss of market gains we'll make employees whole per plan terms.
Diego (Finance): Recon done: omnibus deposit amount $18,350 which matches payroll export within rounding (we had a $50 rounding difference). I'll flag the $50 for manual review.
Noah (Payroll): Good. I'll attach the canonical CSV now (redacted).
Priya (Benefits): Uploaded mapping CSV to Shared/Benefits/Sunrise-Match-Fix/ as `sunrise_match_map_20240426.csv` and included `vest_status` column.
SunriseSupport: Received mapping file. We'll run reapply job and post a per-employee status file in 2 business hours. We'll also provide a checksum to confirm omnibus batch matches.
Marta (Legal): Draft employee notice language suggestion: short paragraph + link to FAQ and an offer to contact Benefits for personal concerns. Avoid legalese but include commitment to make whole and timeline. I'll post a small blurb here by EOD.
Alyssa (People Ops): Good. Decision: Do we plan an off-cycle correction or wait for vendor to reapply? If vendor reapply keeps original pay_date and ledger integrity, no off-cycle needed. If vendor cannot preserve original pay_date we may need to submit a corrective deposit to avoid reporting mismatches.
SunriseSupport: We can preserve original pay_date and will patch the ledger so no off-cycle employer deposit is necessary.
Diego (Finance): As long as omnibus funds reconcile and vendor preserves original pay_date, no extra finance movement. I'll keep monitoring and will escalate if anything else pops.
Noah (Payroll): I'll watch for the per-employee status file and cross-check with payroll ledger.
Priya (Benefits): I'll finalize FAQ and urgent note for distribution once Sunrise confirms per-employee reapply complete. Target: company notice within 6 hours.
BenefitsBot: Doc saved: Shared/Benefits/Sunrise-Match-Fix/README.md (internal)
Alyssa (People Ops): Thanks all. I'll keep leadership in the loop and post the company note once we have confirmation. Keeping this thread as the canonical incident log. :thumbsup:
